title: workout-completed v1 (superseded by v2)
description: SUPERSEDED — use workout-completed-v2.json. Kept unchanged so that leaves already signed under v1 keep verifying forever; v2 expresses the same thing as a profile of leaf.base.json and renames the cosigner role `coach` to `notarized`. See spec/profiles.md. — One finished session, signed by the user's own wallet. It stays off-chain: only its hash enters the monthly Merkle root (see month.sas.json). Nothing identifying and nothing medical — only digests, timestamps, public keys and signal codes.

schema.description: Type and version. A change to any field below is a new version, never an edit.

subject.description: The user's wallet. The same key signs this leaf.

window.description: When the session ran, in UTC seconds. end > start, and end - start <= 6 hours.

activity.description: What kind of effort. Coarse on purpose: the detail lives in the payload.

signals.description: The signals this session actually has. D is always there. No score, no proof level: a reader derives its own.

payloadHash.description: SHA-256 of the off-chain payload (exercises, sets, sensor series). The payload itself never leaves the user unless they show it.

photoHashes.description: SHA-256 of the photo at t0 and at t1, taken in-app. Required with B.

baselineDays.description: How many days of history this device had on this person when the session ran. A week-old watch proves less than a year-old one.

device.description: The sensor behind M and C. Required with M.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature of the cosigner over payloadHash (the 32 raw bytes).

cosigners.description: Required with W (a witness) or N (a verified coach).

meta.description: Free, per app. Never identifying, never medical.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature of the subject over the leaf hash (see schemas/README.md).
